summary: Esperion Therapeutics (ESPR) filed an 8-K announcing entry into a definitive merger agreement with Essence Parent and MergerCo, a subsidiary. Under the agreement, MergerCo will merge with and into Esperion, with Esperion surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Parent. Shareholders will receive $3.16 per share in cash plus one contingent value right (CVR) per share, which entitles holders to up to $100 million in aggregate contingent cash payments upon achieving specified milestones. The transaction is expected to close in Q3 2026, subject to stockholder approval and customary conditions. No board recommendation or advisor is mentioned in the excerpt. The deal effectively takes Esperion private. Watch for stockholder vote and milestone definitions affecting CVR value.
